-- Scale factor for mobile
local UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
UIScale.Parent = MainFrame

local function updateScale()
	local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	local scale = 1

	if isTouchDevice then
		-- Target ~90% of the smaller screen dimension while keeping aspect
		local targetWidth = math.min(viewport.X * 0.92, 520)
		scale = targetWidth / 520
		scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.55, 0.95)
	end

	UIScale.Scale = scale

	-- Keep centered
	local scaledW = 520 * scale
	local scaledH = 420 * scale
	MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -scaledW / 2, 0.5, -scaledH / 2)
end

updateScale()
workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateScale)

-- Make open button draggable on mobile
do
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart, startPos

	MobileOpenBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = MobileOpenBtn.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			MobileOpenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

local snowflakes = {}

local function createSnowflake()
	local size = math.random(3, 6)
	local flake = Instance.new("Frame")
	flake.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	flake.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	flake.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	flake.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flake.ZIndex = 11
	flake.Parent = SnowContainer

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = flake

	local startX = math.random()
	local startY = math.random() * -0.5
	flake.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, startY, 0)

	table.insert(snowflakes, {
		frame = flake,
		speed = math.random(20, 45) / 100,
		drift = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15,
		x = startX,
		y = startY,
		baseTransparency = math.random(30, 55) / 100
	})
end

for i = 1, 60 do
	createSnowflake()
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	for _, flake in ipairs(snowflakes) do
		flake.y = flake.y + flake.speed * dt
		flake.x = flake.x + flake.drift * dt

		local fade = 1
		if flake.y < 0.1 then
			fade = flake.y / 0.1
		elseif flake.y > 0.9 then
			fade = (1.2 - flake.y) / 0.3
		end
		fade = math.clamp(fade, 0, 1)

		flake.frame.BackgroundTransparency = flake.baseTransparency + (1 - fade) * 0.5

		if flake.y > 1.2 then
			flake.y = -0.15
			flake.x = math.random()
			flake.speed = math.random(20, 45) / 100
			flake.drift = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15
			flake.baseTransparency = math.random(30, 55) / 100
		end

		if flake.x < -0.1 then flake.x = 1.1 end
		if flake.x > 1.1 then flake.x = -0.1 end

		flake.frame.Position = UDim2.new(flake.x, 0, flake.y, 0)
	end
end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- CHAIN FLING LOGIC
----------------------------------------------------
local GrabRange = 999
local AimCone = 999
local DogsFolderName = "NPCs"
local FlingDuration = 2
local FlingSpeed = 9999
local AimRate = 9999
local MaxChain = 1
local ChainDelay = 0

local holding = nil
local flinging = false
local chaining = false
local stopChain = false

local function getRay()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local isFirstPerson = head and (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude <= 1.5

	-- Prefer camera look on touch devices / first person
	if isTouchDevice or isFirstPerson then
		return cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector
	end

	local unitRay = Mouse.UnitRay
	return unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction
end

local function pickDog(preferAim)
	local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(DogsFolderName)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (folder and hrp) then return nil end

	local origin, direction = getRay()
	local bestDog, bestScore = nil, math.huge

	for _, dog in folder:GetChildren() do
		local humanoid = dog:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local torso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and torso then
			local dist = (torso.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
			if dist <= GrabRange then
				local score = dist
				if preferAim then
					local toDog = (torso.Position - origin).Unit
					local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(direction:Dot(toDog), -1, 1))
					if not isTouchDevice and Mouse.Target and Mouse.Target:IsDescendantOf(dog) then
						angle = -1
					end
					if angle < math.rad(AimCone) then
						score = angle
					else
						score = dist + 100
					end
				end
				if score < bestScore then
					bestDog = dog
					bestScore = score
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if bestDog then
		return bestDog, (bestDog.Torso.Position - origin).Magnitude
	end
	return nil
end

local function getClosestOtherDog(exclude)
	local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(DogsFolderName)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local heldTorso = exclude and exclude:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if not heldTorso then return nil end

	local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _, dog in folder:GetChildren() do
		if dog ~= exclude then
			local humanoid = dog:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local torso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and torso then
				local dist = (torso.Position - heldTorso.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < closestDist and dist < 130 then
					closest = dog
					closestDist = dist
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end

local function release()
	if not holding then return end
	holding = nil
	flinging = false
	pcall(function() Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Release") end)
end

local function startFling(dog)
	flinging = true
	local startTime = os.clock()

	while holding and flinging and not stopChain and os.clock() - startTime < FlingDuration do
		local target = getClosestOtherDog(dog)
		local heldTorso = dog:FindFirstChild("Torso")

		if heldTorso then
			if target and target:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
				local targetPos = target.Torso.Position
				local myPos = heldTorso.Position
				local dir = (targetPos - myPos)
				dir = dir.Magnitude > 0.1 and dir.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

				pcall(function()
					Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Aim", targetPos + dir * 20)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					heldTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * FlingSpeed + Vector3.new(0, 55, 0)
				end)
			else
				pcall(function()
					Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Aim", heldTorso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 90, 0))
					heldTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 350, 0)
				end)
			end
		end
		task.wait(1 / AimRate)
	end
	release()
end

local function runChain()
	if chaining then return end
	chaining = true
	stopChain = false

	for i = 1, MaxChain do
		if stopChain then break end
		local dog, distance = pickDog(i == 1)
		if not dog then break end

		holding = { dog = dog, distance = distance, sentAt = 0, grabbedAt = os.clock() }
		pcall(function() Net:Fire("Manipulator", "Grab", dog, distance) end)
		task.wait(0.06)

		if stopChain then
			release()
			break
		end

		startFling(dog)
		if stopChain then break end
		task.wait(ChainDelay)
	end

	chaining = false
	stopChain = false
	release()
end

-- Mobile fling / stop buttons
FlingBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if ChainFlingEnabled and not chaining then
		task.spawn(runChain)
	end
end)

StopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

		local track = skillGui:FindFirstChild("Track", true)
		local zone = track and track:FindFirstChild("Zone", true)
		local pointer = track and track:FindFirstChild("Pointer", true)

		if zone and pointer then
			local pX = pointer.Position.X.Scale
			local zX = zone.Position.X.Scale
			local zWidth = zone.Size.X.Scale
			if pX >= zX and pX <= (zX + zWidth) then
				SkillCheckRemote:FireServer()
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end
	end
end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- ANTI RAGDOLL
----------------------------------------------------
local function fixJointsAndState(character)
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)

	if humanoid.UseJumpPower then
		humanoid.JumpPower = 50
	else
		humanoid.JumpHeight = 7.2
	end

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or desc:IsA("HingeConstraint") or desc:IsA("RopeConstraint") or desc:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") then
			desc:Destroy()
		elseif desc:IsA("Motor6D") then
			desc.Enabled = true
		end
	end

	local animateScript = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if animateScript then
		if animateScript.Disabled then
			animateScript.Disabled = false
		else
			animateScript.Disabled = true
			task.wait()
			animateScript.Disabled = false
		end
	end
end

local function applyAntiRagdoll(character)
	if not character then return end
	character:SetAttribute("Ragdolled", false)
	character:SetAttribute("Shocked", nil)
	fixJointsAndState(character)

	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ragdolled"):Connect(function()
		if AntiRagdollEnabled then
			task.wait()
			character:SetAttribute("Ragdolled", false)
			fixJointsAndState(character)
		end
	end)
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Shocked"):Connect(function()
		if AntiRagdollEnabled then
			character:SetAttribute("Shocked", nil)
		end
	end)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLES
----------------------------------------------------
local function toggleNoSpread()
	NoSpreadEnabled = not NoSpreadEnabled
	setToggleVisual(NoSpreadToggle, NoSpreadKnob, NoSpreadEnabled)
end

local function applyStamina(character)
	if character and InfiniteStaminaEnabled then
		character:SetAttribute("Epicsauce", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 999999)
	end
end

local function toggleStamina()
	InfiniteStaminaEnabled = not InfiniteStaminaEnabled
	if InfiniteStaminaEnabled then
		applyStamina(LocalPlayer.Character)
	elseif LocalPlayer.Character then
		LocalPlayer.Character:SetAttribute("Epicsauce", nil)
	end
	setToggleVisual(StaminaToggle, StaminaKnob, InfiniteStaminaEnabled)
end

local function toggleAntiRagdoll()
	AntiRagdollEnabled = not AntiRagdollEnabled
	if AntiRagdollEnabled then
		applyAntiRagdoll(LocalPlayer.Character)
	end
	setToggleVisual(AntiRagdollToggle, AntiRagdollKnob, AntiRagdollEnabled)
end

local function toggleAutoSkill()

	setToggleVisual(AutoSkillToggle, AutoSkillKnob, AutoSkillCheckEnabled)
end

local function toggleAutoHopium()
	AutoHopiumEnabled = not AutoHopiumEnabled
	setToggleVisual(AutoHopiumToggle, AutoHopiumKnob, AutoHopiumEnabled)
end

local function toggleChainFling()
	ChainFlingEnabled = not ChainFlingEnabled
	if not ChainFlingEnabled then
		stopChain = true
		release()
	end
	setToggleVisual(ChainFlingToggle, ChainFlingKnob, ChainFlingEnabled)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	if InfiniteStaminaEnabled then
		task.wait(0.5)
		applyStamina(char)
	end
	if AntiRagdollEnabled then
		task.wait(0.5)
		applyAntiRagdoll(char)
	end
end)

----------------------------------------------------
-- ESP & CAMERA
----------------------------------------------------
local ActiveMarks = {}
local FoldersToScan = {
	{ Name = "Characters", Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 255), PlayersOnly = true },
	{ Name = "NPCs", Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55), Named = { Cremator = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) } }
}

local function clearESP()
	for model, highlight in pairs(ActiveMarks) do
		if highlight and highlight.Parent then highlight:Destroy() end
	end
	table.clear(ActiveMarks)
end

local function updateESP()
	if not EspEnabled then return end
	local LocalChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	local CurrentTargets = {}

	for _, folderData in ipairs(FoldersToScan) do
		local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(folderData.Name)
		if folder then
			for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				local humanoid = model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and model ~= LocalChar then
					local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
					if not folderData.PlayersOnly or isPlayer then
						CurrentTargets[model] = true
						local highlight = ActiveMarks[model]
						if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
							highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
							highlight.Name = "RadarMark"
							highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
							highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
							highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
							highlight.Adornee = model
							highlight.Parent = model
							ActiveMarks[model] = highlight
						end
						local customColor = folderData.Named and folderData.Named[model.Name]
						highlight.FillColor = customColor or folderData.Color
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for model, highlight in pairs(ActiveMarks) do
		if not CurrentTargets[model] then
			if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
			ActiveMarks[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function toggleEsp()
	EspEnabled = not EspEnabled
	if not EspEnabled then clearESP() end
	setToggleVisual(EspToggle, EspKnob, EspEnabled)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if EspEnabled then pcall(updateESP) end
		task.wait(0.4)
	end
end)

local function toggleCameraEffects()
	CameraEffectsEnabled = not CameraEffectsEnabled
	if not CameraEffectsEnabled then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("StreetsCameraBob")
		local ScreenEffect = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ScreenEffectBrightness")
		if ScreenEffect then ScreenEffect.Brightness = 0 end
	end
	setToggleVisual(CamToggle, CamKnob, CameraEffectsEnabled)
end

----------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECTIONS
----------------------------------------------------
NoSpreadToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleNoSpread)
StaminaToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleStamina)
AntiRagdollToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleAntiRagdoll)
AutoSkillToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleAutoSkill)
AutoHopiumToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleAutoHopium)
ChainFlingToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleChainFling)
EspToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleEsp)
CamToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleCameraEffects)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then toggleStamina() end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.J then toggleAntiRagdoll() end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then toggleAutoSkill() end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then toggleAutoHopium() end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.H then toggleEsp() end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
		if MainFrame.Visible then updateScale() end
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E and ChainFlingEnabled then
		if not chaining then
			task.spawn(runChain)
		end
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
		stopChain = true
		release()
	end
end)

-- Optional: hide mobile action buttons when menu is open (cleaner)
MainFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if isTouchDevice then
		MobileActions.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
	end
end)
